answer_4.quote: We conduct a human evaluation on WoW and DSTC9 with the help of three expert annotators, using the Attributable to Identified Source (AIS) framework.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to score responses as attributable (A) only if all their content can be attributed to the knowledge, cooperativeness (C) on a 3-point Likert scale, and paraphrasing (P) on a binary scale.
